title: 探秘星际之门：OpenAI 5000亿美元AI工厂
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Stargate put that name down in your books because I think you're going to hear a lot about it in the future a new American company that will invest
segments.zh: 记住星门这个名字，未来你会经常听到它。这家新成立的美国公司将**至少5000亿美元用于AI基础设施。

segments.en: 500 billion dollars at least in AI infrastructure.
segments.zh: 数据中心已在建设中，首批位于德克萨斯州。

segments.en: The data centers are actually under construction. The first of them are under construction in Texas.
segments.zh: 阿比林是我们的第一个选址。

segments.en: The Abilene location which is our first location.
segments.zh: 阿比林位于德克萨斯州中西部平原，我们为每一个机遇而奋斗。

segments.en: Abilene is a town on the western central plains of Texas. We kind of scratch and fight for everything good that comes our way.
segments.zh: 有人问我总统会不会来，我说他还没通知我。

segments.en: I had people reaching out and I said was the president going to come see you? And I said will he as it takes me yet?
segments.zh: 我很激动能在美国开展这个项目，这将是这个时代最重要的工程。

segments.en: I'm thrilled we get to do this in the United States of America. I think this will be the most important project of this era.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到德克萨斯州阿比林，这里是星门项目的所在地。

segments.en: Welcome to Abilene Texas. This is the site of Project Stargate.
segments.zh: 一个神秘且备受关注的项目，汇集了OpenAI、软银和甲骨文。

segments.en: A very mysterious, much talked about, much speculated about project that brings together open AI, soft bank, Oracle.
segments.zh: 如果一切顺利，这片红土地上的建筑将装满芯片，驱动AI革命。

segments.en: If it all comes together, building after building on this red dirt behind me will be filled with chips that will power the AI revolution.
segments.zh: 如果一切顺利，我身后这片红土地上的建筑将装满芯片，驱动AI革命。

segments.en: What we're undergoing right now is the largest infrastructure building human history.
segments.zh: 我们正在经历人类历史上最大的基础设施建设。

segments.en: It's going to create new ways of doing business. It's going to create new ways of invention. And it's going to really drive humanity forward.
segments.zh: 它将创造新的商业模式和发明方式，真正推动人类前进。

segments.en: I was in the real estate business. These buildings, these are big beautiful buildings. They're going to employ a lot of people.
segments.zh: 我曾从事房地产行业。这些建筑宏伟而美丽，将雇佣大量人员。

segments.en: How do you personally grapple with the pace of it all?
segments.zh: 您个人如何应对这一切的节奏？
